name: Sentry
summary: Reads how many app sessions ran each day and how many of them crashed, and (with the event:read scope) your open Sentry issues, from your Sentry account every 30 minutes.

settings.label: Organization slug (the part after /organizations/ in your Sentry web address, e.g. my-team)
Data region: leave empty for sentry.io, or type de.sentry.io if your Sentry account is hosted in the EU
App names (optional): project-slug=App Name, separated by commas, e.g. my-app=My App. Empty uses the Sentry project names
Auth token (Sentry → Settings → Auth Tokens → Create New Token, scopes: org:read, project:read; add event:read to get open issues, website-down and job alerts)
